status: design-model-frozen; no pilot input, simulation receipt, or selected seed count exists
reason: Fourteen component tests include paired composites whose dependence is not identified by twenty-slot marginal upper-SD summaries. Treating them as independent could overstate complete-family power.
componentScreeningRule: Every component of a member must pass its registered one-sided test and practical direction at alpha 0.05/9. A member's p-value remains the maximum component p-value for the registered global-Holm analysis.
selectionAuthority: For each candidate, calculate a two-sided 95% Wilson lower power bound for each of the nine complete member decisions. The dependence-robust family lower bound is max(0, 1 - sum over members of (1 - member lower bound)). The smallest candidate with family lower bound at least 0.90 and reserve-adequacy probability at least 0.95 is selected.
jointSimulationRole: Also report the 30000-repetition joint-family result under the registered dependence model as a diagnostic. It cannot select a smaller N than the dependence-robust family lower bound permits.
pilotDispersionRule: Use each component's one-sided 95% upper SD from the complete twenty-slot pilot. H5's binary components use their registered design probabilities rather than a Gaussian SD approximation.
reserveRule: For each experiment, use the pilot's one-sided 95% upper invalid-run probability and require at least 0.95 probability of obtaining N valid runs within N plus ceil(0.10*N) registered attempts. Failure requires a prospective reserve-allocation amendment; it cannot be ignored or repaired after outcomes.

designAlternatives.test: one-sided exact binomial; second component counts seed ratios above 1.25
two one-sided seed-level t tests, greater, combined by maximum p-value

failureRule: If no candidate passes either the dependence-robust power gate or reserve-adequacy gate, no confirmatory prefix may be registered. Margins cannot be widened and pilot data cannot be discarded; redesign or resources must be amended prospectively.
claimBoundary: This freezes a conservative future power model. It is not a pilot, power simulation, selected sample size, resource authorization, study outcome, independent review, or publication result.
